initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault introduced upstream. The stipulated needs records use record_id values like n06-r01, but the upstream provenance handoff contains record_id values s01 through s08. The supplied source for assemble_provenance shows it writes record_id from source_id, so downstream priority ranking cannot match coverage record_ids to provenance ranks and all observed upstream_rank values are 0. This violates preservation of record identity and deterministic upstream provenance. The downstream output is consistent with receiving the faulty evidence_sources handoff, so the supported localization is job_1 assemble_provenance.
